narrative: Opex of NOK 1,010M converts NOK 1,690M of GP into NOK 680M adjusted EBITDA (40.2% of GP). Personnel is NOK 640M for about 700 FTE; platform & cloud NOK 185M, of which NOK 57M runs four legacy SMSC platforms scheduled to migrate onto MyLINK CORE.

signals.title: Adjusted EBITDA NOK 680M — 40.2% of GP, gate passed
signals.source: SDP GP & EBITDA Consolidation — 21 markets, 6 planning markets
signals.excerpt: Opex of NOK 1,010M (personnel NOK 640M, platform & cloud NOK 185M). The finance gate passes: within 5% of ambition and above the 38% EBITDA floor. Four legacy SMSC platforms migrate onto MyLINK CORE.
